title: Solar photovoltaic water pump with maximum power point tracking for small farms
abstract: A synthetic test record describing a solar-powered centrifugal irrigation pump using MPPT control, a brushless DC motor, and dry-run protection for MSME farms.
claims: 1. A solar water pumping apparatus comprising a photovoltaic array, an MPPT controller, and a brushless DC motor coupled to a centrifugal pump. 2. The apparatus of claim 1 further comprising a dry-run sensor that stops the pump when suction pressure falls below a threshold. 3. The apparatus of claim 1 wherein the controller stores excess solar energy in a small lead-acid buffer battery.
description: This SYNTHETIC FIXTURE describes a farm irrigation pump driven by photovoltaic modules. The controller tracks the maximum power point of the array and drives a BLDC motor. Farmers can irrigate without grid electricity. The description includes float-switch tank control and over-temperature shutdown. This is not an authentic patent.

title: Soil-moisture sensor network for drip irrigation valves
abstract: Synthetic capacitive soil sensors communicate over LoRa to open drip valves only when root-zone moisture drops below a crop-specific threshold.
claims: 1. A drip irrigation control system comprising capacitive soil-moisture probes, a LoRa gateway, and latching solenoid valves. 2. The system of claim 1 wherein irrigation duration is computed from crop type and recent evapotranspiration estimates. 3. The system of claim 1 further comprising a filter that discards noisy moisture samples after rainfall.
description: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE. Low-cost probes are buried in the root zone of vegetable beds. A microcontroller opens drip laterals zone by zone. The system reduces water use compared with timer-only drip kits. Not an authentic patent.

title: Solar-assisted drip irrigation controller combining moisture sensing and photovoltaic pumping
abstract: A synthetic combined system where a photovoltaic pump fills a header tank and soil-moisture sensors release drip lines, intended to test semantic aggregation of related irrigation art.
claims: 1. An irrigation plant comprising a photovoltaic pump, an elevated header tank, and soil-moisture gated drip laterals. 2. The plant of claim 1 wherein the pump starts only when tank level is low and irradiance exceeds a threshold.
description: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE combining solar pumping and drip control so queries about solar drip irrigation retrieve multiple related records. Not an authentic patent.

title: Low-temperature vacuum extractor for turmeric oleoresin
abstract: Synthetic vacuum evaporator extracts curcumin-rich oleoresin from turmeric rhizomes at reduced temperature to limit thermal degradation.
claims: 1. A vacuum extraction vessel for turmeric comprising a steam jacket, a condenser, and a solvent recovery loop. 2. The vessel of claim 1 operated below 60 C to preserve curcuminoids.
description: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE for herbal processing MSMEs. Ethanol solvent is recovered. Not an authentic patent.

title: Battery pack liquid cooling plate for electric three-wheelers
abstract: Synthetic aluminum cooling plate with serpentine channels removes heat from lithium-ion modules used in cargo rickshaws.
claims: 1. A battery thermal management plate comprising serpentine coolant channels bonded to prismatic cell faces. 2. The plate of claim 1 further comprising a thermostat-controlled 12 V pump and radiator.
description: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE. Addresses thermal runaway risk in dense city-duty electric rickshaw packs. Not an authentic patent.

title: Rice-husk ash panel for low-cost building insulation
abstract: Synthetic composite boards mix rice-husk ash, lime, and natural fibers to form insulating wall panels for hot-dry climates.
claims: 1. An insulation panel comprising rice-husk ash, hydrated lime, and jute fiber. 2. The panel of claim 1 having thermal conductivity below a stated laboratory target for the fixture.
description: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE converting agricultural residue into building material. Not an authentic patent.

title: Electrocoagulation unit for textile dyeing wastewater
abstract: Synthetic iron-electrode electrocoagulation reactor removes color and suspended solids from small dye-house effluent.
claims: 1. A wastewater reactor comprising sacrificial iron electrodes, a DC supply, and a lamella clarifier. 2. The reactor of claim 1 wherein polarity is reversed periodically to reduce scaling.
description: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE aimed at MSME dye houses that cannot afford large ETPs. Not an authentic patent.

title: Evaporative cold room for mango storage using solar chimney draft
abstract: Synthetic evaporative cooling chamber keeps mangoes in a humid cooled airflow driven by a solar chimney instead of vapor-compression refrigeration.
claims: 1. A produce store comprising wet cellulose pads, a solar chimney, and stacked crates. 2. The store of claim 1 maintaining high humidity to reduce mango shrivel.
description: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE for horticulture MSMEs without reliable three-phase power. Not an authentic patent.

title: Fixed-dome biogas digester with cattle-dung mixer
abstract: Synthetic household biogas plant mixes cattle dung and water, captures methane, and provides slurry for fertilizer.
claims: 1. A biogas digester comprising an inlet mixing tank, a floating or fixed dome, and a slurry outlet. 2. The digester of claim 1 including a hand stirrer to reduce scum formation.

title: Polycentric prosthetic knee with stance-phase lock for low-cost limbs
abstract: Synthetic four-bar prosthetic knee offers stability in stance and free swing, intended for clinic-level fabrication.
claims: 1. A prosthetic knee comprising a four-bar linkage and a stance-phase locking cam. 2. The knee of claim 1 fabricated from aluminum and polymer bushings.
description: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE for assistive technology workshops. Not an authentic patent.

title: Ultraviolet LED mosquito trap with CO2 lure from yeast
abstract: Synthetic trap combines UV LEDs, a yeast-sugar carbon dioxide lure, and a fan into a sticky or mesh capture chamber.
claims: 1. A mosquito trap comprising UV LEDs, a yeast CO2 generator, and a suction fan. 2. The trap of claim 1 using a replaceable sticky cartridge.

title: Waste-heat recovery hood for brick kiln flue gases
abstract: Synthetic heat exchanger in a brick-kiln flue preheats combustion air and optionally dries bricks.
claims: 1. A kiln heat-recovery assembly comprising a flue-gas to air exchanger and a bypass damper. 2. The assembly of claim 1 wherein recovered heat dries green bricks.

title: Smartphone clip-on lens and model for leaf disease screening
abstract: Synthetic optical clip and on-device classifier flags common crop leaf diseases from close-up images.
claims: 1. A crop scouting accessory comprising a macro lens clip and an on-device image classifier. 2. The accessory of claim 1 providing a confidence score rather than a diagnosis.
description: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE. Intended to match queries about computer-vision agriculture tools. Not an authentic patent.

title: Jute-fiber biodegradable packaging tray for vegetables
abstract: Synthetic hot-pressed jute and starch trays replace expanded polystyrene for retail produce.
claims: 1. A packaging tray comprising jute fiber and a starch binder formed in a heated mold. 2. The tray of claim 1 being water-resistant for a limited retail window.
description: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE for packaging MSMEs. Not an authentic patent.

title: Household rainwater first-flush diverter and ceramic filter
abstract: Synthetic rooftop rainwater system discards the first dirty flush then filters water through ceramic candles.
claims: 1. A rainwater system comprising a first-flush diverter, a storage tank, and ceramic candle filters. 2. The system of claim 1 including a mesh leaf screen on the gutter outlet.

title: Compact three-axis CNC mill with ball-screw drive for job shops
abstract: Synthetic benchtop CNC milling machine uses ball screws, stepper motors, and an enclosed splash guard for MSME workshops.
claims: 1. A CNC mill comprising three ball-screw axes, stepper motors, and a GRBL-class controller. 2. The mill of claim 1 including a coolant tray and interlocking guard.
description: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE for machine-tool builders. Not an authentic patent.

title: Indirect solar dryer for turmeric fingers with rock-bed heat storage
abstract: Synthetic solar air heater charges a rock bed that continues drying turmeric after sunset.
claims: 1. A solar dryer comprising a flat-plate air heater, a rock-bed store, and a drying chamber. 2. The dryer of claim 1 maintaining airflow with a DC fan powered by a small PV module.
description: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE related to spice processing and solar heat, distinct from the oleoresin extractor. Not an authentic patent.

title: Neighborhood EV charger with load balancing across a weak feeder
abstract: Synthetic charge controller shares a limited distribution transformer among several two-wheeler chargers.
claims: 1. A charging system comprising multiple EV outlets and a controller that throttles current to respect feeder limits. 2. The system of claim 1 prioritizing vehicles with lower state of charge.
description: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE for energy-access MSMEs. Not an authentic patent.

title: Paddle-wheel aerator with solar assist for small aquaculture ponds
abstract: Synthetic pond aerator uses a geared motor and optional photovoltaic assist to maintain dissolved oxygen.
claims: 1. An aerator comprising a paddle wheel, a geared motor, and a float frame. 2. The aerator of claim 1 further comprising a PV array that offsets grid consumption during daylight.

title: Enzyme-assisted leather unhairing process reducing sulfide use
abstract: Synthetic enzymatic unhairing bath lowers sodium sulfide demand in small tanneries.
claims: 1. A leather unhairing process comprising a protease enzyme bath and reduced sulfide dosing. 2. The process of claim 1 recovering residual enzyme for a subsequent hide lot.
description: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE for tannery pollution control. Not an authentic patent.
